Implement the core auth models and DTOs in Spring Boot 3 (Jakarta Persistence):
1. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/dto/RegisterRequest.java (record or class with email, password, firstName, lastName, Jakarta @NotBlank, @Email, @Size)
2. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/dto/LoginRequest.java (record or class with email, password, Jakarta validation)
3. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/dto/AuthResponse.java (record or class with accessToken, tokenType, email, userId)
4. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/model/User.java (Jakarta entity mapping to 'users' table matching V1 schema: id, email, passwordHash, firstName, lastName, isVerified, createdAt, updatedAt)
5. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/repository/UserRepository.java (Spring Data JpaRepository<User, Long> with Optional<User> findByEmail(String email), boolean existsByEmail(String email))
